name: fspecial
expr: h = fspecial("average", 3); r1 = double(numel(h)); h2 = fspecial('disk',2); d2n = numel(h2); d2c = h2(3,3); d2corner = h2(1,1); d2edge = h2(3,1); d2off = h2(2,2); d2sum = sum(h2(:)); h3 = fspecial('disk',3); d3n = numel(h3); d3c = h3(4,4); h5 = fspecial('disk',5); d5n = numel(h5); d5c = h5(6,6);
comment: Sig: h = fspecial(type, params). DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31 (c160): fspecial('disk',r) now computes MATLAB R2025b's EXACT sub-pixel area-coverage integral (the fraction of each unit cell inside the disk of radius r), not the previous linear-taper approximation (self-admitted 'Approximate area inside disk'). Bit-exact vs MATLAB across r=1..10: disk(2) is 5x5, sum=1, centre h(3,3)=0.0795774715, corner h(1,1)=0, mid-edge h(3,1)=0.0381149714, h(2,2)=0.0783813542; disk(3) centre h(4,4)=0.0353677651; disk(5) is 11x11 centre h(6,6)=0.0127323954. Also fixed the kernel SIZE for non-integer r (now 2*ceil(r-0.5)+1 per MATLAB). 'average'/'gaussian'/'laplacian'/'log'/'sobel'/'prewitt' unchanged. covers:[fspecial].
